proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: an fpqc covering {T_i} induces an fpqc covering {X_i -> X_T} with the expected fibre-product compatibilities; compatible quotient data glue by the remark-q-sheaf observation to a surjection F_T -> Q of quasi-coherent modules; Q is flat over T by the flat-permanence lemma; in the Q^fp case finite presentation descends by the descent-on-spaces lemma (source lines 2026-2048)
